html_source:
Bantam Lyons is trying to handicap the Gold Cup at Ascot. Bloom’s innocuous comment about trashing his paper catches Lyon’s interest because there is a horse in the third race named Throwaway. The horse Throwaway would win the 1904 Gold Cup.
